milestones.description: Design and validate the PostgreSQL schema for all 22 data modules.
Implement CIDOC CRM core, CRMarchaeo, CRMsci, CRMgeo, and CRMinf as PostgreSQL extensions and TTL ontology files.
Stand up Docker Compose services for PostgreSQL/PostGIS, Directus, Apache Jena, MinIO, Cantaloupe, GeoServer, MeiliSearch, and FastAPI.
Implement FastAPI validation for EDTF dates, Harris Matrix acyclicity, and geometry topology.
Populate controlled-vocabulary SKOS concept schemes, including the Getty AAT subset, material types, event types, and feature types.
Establish the Zotero group library and test its synchronization job.
Configure local JupyterHub and test the Stratigraphy Builder and C14 Plotter notebooks with a synthetic dataset.

phases.name: Beta — Testing on Omeka S
phases.platform: Hosted Omeka S; supporting services local or self-hosted

milestones.description: Deploy Omeka S with custom Item Types mapped to Pleroma entity types using CIDOC CRM vocabulary.
Develop the Aletheion Omeka S theme with Deep Map, Civilization Dashboard stub, and Climate Context sidebar.
Develop and test the IIIF viewer module and Cantaloupe integration in Omeka S.
Ingest at least five complete site hierarchies (site → periods → strata → finds), with records completeness-validated to the Gold trust-score standard.
Test site → period → stratum → find → provenance and civilization → polity phase → ruler → events → battle navigation.
Launch a limited Agora transcription pilot and test moderation and contribution workflows.
Collect structured user feedback and iterate on interface design and data-entry workflows.
Complete an authorized security assessment of FastAPI endpoints, review role-based access control, and verify Legal_Status export restrictions.

exit_criteria.description: At least 100 records exist across at least five site hierarchies.
All specified navigation modules are functional.

phases.name: Release v1.0 — Production Domain
phases.platform: Dedicated production domain and cloud infrastructure

milestones.description: Acquire project-aletheion.org and the Pleroma subdomain.
Deploy the full Kubernetes stack with TLS, CDN, and automated backups.
Activate SPARQL federation with the Literature Database and test cross-database motif queries end to end.
Activate JupyterHub on Kubernetes for credentialed researcher access.
Publish REST API and SPARQL endpoint documentation.
Launch public access to published data through the REST API and SPARQL endpoint.
Publish the initial data corpus with a DOI through a recognized data repository.
Activate Prometheus/Grafana monitoring and establish incident-response procedures.

exit_criteria.description: The full-stack production deployment is operational.

milestones.description: Systematically ingest published excavation reports for priority regions.
Implement the battle tactical map module with a phase slider.
Develop the VR site exploration interface and photogrammetry model streaming.
Activate acoustic simulation and sensory reconstruction features.
Begin development of the Aletheion Literature Database as a federated sibling instance.
Pursue data-sharing partnerships with museums, research institutes, and national heritage bodies.
